Field notes / Spellworks 1.0

A laboratory for the impossible.

Cast the selected spellSpace / Cast button
Choose a spell1 – 8
Switch casting modeQ
Orbit / Zoom / PanDrag / Wheel / Right-drag
Aim and cast at a locationDouble-click the arena
Automatic cast / PauseA / P
Cinematic orbit / Reset cameraC / R
Slow motion / Hide interfaceT / H

Every spell has its own motion and particle behavior, not just a different tint. Try a Frost Volley, a Storm Beam, or a Void Nova. Flight settings apply to new casts; turbulence, density and bloom respond live.

STANDALONE & PORTABLE

The standard HTML loads a pinned Three.js module from a CDN. No other files, textures, accounts, or build tools are required. After it loads, Save fully offline HTML embeds Three.js into a new copy. Export / import preserves your effect settings.

WORLDWORKS / INTEGRATION

window.Spellworks exposes cast, setPreset, configure, pause, clear, getState, getStats, and the engine class. See the included README for scene integration.

Art direction and procedural effects generated for your engine collection. This is a visual-effects sandbox, not an authoritative combat or collision engine. Strobing effects are possible with lightning; pause or choose another spell as needed.
